About the clinic

A neighbourhood clinic your family can relax in

Tucked into a quiet street in G-13/3, Anum Family Dental was set up with one simple idea: a visit to the dentist should feel easy — for a nervous five-year-old, a busy parent, and everyone in between.

We take time to explain every treatment in plain words before we begin, agree on the plan together, and keep appointments unhurried. Whether you are coming in for a routine check-up, a child's first filling, or a complete smile makeover, you will be looked after by a team that treats you like family.

  • Gentle, unhurried appointments for children and adults
  • Every treatment explained clearly before it starts
  • Easy booking by phone or WhatsApp — no long waits
  • Right here in G-13/3 — close to home for local families
Our services

Complete dental care, all in one place

From everyday check-ups to full smile transformations — here is what your family can come to us for.

General Dentistry

Regular check-ups, fillings, root canal treatment and extractions — the everyday care that keeps teeth healthy and catches small problems before they become painful ones.

Kids' Dentistry

Friendly, patient-first care for little ones — first check-ups, fluoride protection, fillings for milk teeth and gentle guidance that helps children feel brave in the chair.

Cleaning & Whitening

Professional scaling and polishing removes plaque, tartar and surface stains, while whitening treatments brighten your smile safely for a fresher, more confident look.

Braces & Orthodontics

Straighten crowded, gappy or misaligned teeth with braces for teenagers and adults. We plan your treatment step by step, so you always know what comes next.

Dental Implants

A strong, natural-feeling way to replace missing teeth. Implants let you eat, speak and smile with confidence again — a long-lasting alternative to removable dentures.

Check-ups & Advice

Not sure what your teeth need? Book a consultation and we will examine your mouth, talk through your options honestly, and help you decide — with no pressure.

Every smile is different, so treatment plans and costs are confirmed at your consultation. Call for consultation rates →
